sources.label: Official Mint Velvet size guide (XS–XL sizing, cm; UK and US views)

audit: Site moved to mintvelvet.com (old /help/size-guide is a 404). Official chart is UK 6–18 (stored was UK 8–20): UK 8 bust 84→82, hips 90→91; UK 10 bust 88→86, waist 69→70, hips 94→96; UK 16 bust 102→105, waist 83→87, hips 108→113; UK 18 bust 108→110, waist 89→93, hips 114→119. UK 20 is not published, so it was removed; UK 6 added. US from the guide's US view (UK 6 = US 2 … UK 18 = US 14). EU removed: the guide's EU view shows the UK numbers unchanged, so no EU conversion is reliably published. Letter sizes (S covers UK 8–10, L covers UK 14–16) kept as altLabel.
notes: UK brand targeting 35–55 demographic. UK sizing runs true, with a slightly generous, relaxed silhouette. Smart-casual and occasion focus. Consistent sizing across seasons. Official size guide covers UK 6–18 (XS–XL, with S = UK 8–10 and L = UK 14–16). Publishes body measurements on size guide.
